{{Top|leg}}
The '''Andrim Shipyards''' was one of the three primary facilities of the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] [[Kuat Drive Yards Orbital Array|Orbital Array]] that constructed [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. It was located in a ring of other installations that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], and was related to [[House Andrim]], one of [[the Ten]].<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
